components.title: Compare order revenues
components.what: ORD-1845 has the largest revenue: 40 × 117.63 = 4705.20; FINAL: ORD-1845

log.author: D
log.draft:
Comparing revenue = units × unit_price across all 20 rows, the largest is ORD-1845: 40 × 117.63 = 4705.20. The next largest is ORD-1177 at 20 × 110.62 = 2212.40, well below ORD-1845. Status does not affect the requirement since “any status” is allowed.

FINAL: ORD-1845
